title: Cyclops Helmet Fix
description: Fixes helmets for Skinds with one centered eye aka Cyclops
body:
This texture pack adjusts all helmets so they line up properly with cyclops-style player models. No more off-center eye slots.. You can finally see the your eyes without the nose bar in the middle of your Face. _Designed from a one-eyed dude for one-eyed skins._


Before:
![Can't see you!](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/XJoEFhG9/images/3edfe9ee203f12bc37e63727fe37c7b6c0746f41.png)

After:
![Fixed](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/XJoEFhG9/images/221e8058919b88e9623a3aac1db213666c5efe06.png)
